title: Flametroopers Burn the Village
description: Flametroopers utilize their D-93 Incinerator flamethrowers against any resident of Tuanul that creates interference in their mission to locate Lor San Tekka and Poe Dameron. The flamethrowers contain extremely volatile flammable gel that, when launched, can travel a distance of up to 75 meters, depending on local wind conditions.
